# Built-in Profiles

The four built-in `SandboxProfile` objects, from the profile matrix in section 10 of the AgentSandbox threat model, generated from `crates/sandboxpolicy-core/src/builtin.rs`. Every knob in the register appears in every profile; a test enforces it. A policy moves one knob one step above its profile only through a time-boxed, approved KnobGrant.

| Profile | Data scope | For |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fortress` | `Internal` | Analysis of sensitive material with no outbound path |
| `hardened` | `Internal` | Code and document work against internal systems, read-only |
| `standard` | `Internal` | Everyday engineering work |
| `lab` | `LabOnly` | Experiments and tool evaluation on non-production data |
